subject: Geopolitics
title: The New Energy Superpowers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The New Energy Superpowers.

hook.text: Chile has sun. Morocco has wind. Australia has both. The green energy map looks nothing like the oil one.

buildup.text: Renewable energy shifts power from oil producers to nations with sun, wind, lithium, and rare earths.

discovery.text: Countries that master green energy will set the rules of the 21st-century economy. It's a new geopolitical race.

twist.text: China dominates solar panel and battery manufacturing. It could control the green economy like OPEC controls oil.

climax.text: The US and EU are subsidizing domestic green industries with hundreds of billions. The subsidy war is on.

punchline.text: The energy source changes. The fight for control doesn't.

quiz.question: Why does the green energy transition shift geopolitical power?
options: Renewable energy is free and eliminates competition
Power shifts from oil producers to nations with sun, wind, and minerals
All nations have equal renewable resources
